# Hyperwrike

> Hyperwrike (hyperwrike.com) is an AI systems agency, founded in 2024 and based in Chennai, India, that builds custom, done-for-you AI voice agents, AI receptionists, WhatsApp AI agents, speed-to-lead follow-up, database reactivation and custom CRM automation for businesses in the United States, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, Europe and India. Not to be confused with HyperWrite (an AI writing tool) or Wrike (project management software).

## Key facts

- Services: AI voice calling agents and AI receptionists; AI chat and WhatsApp agents; speed-to-lead (callback within 60 seconds); no-show reduction sequences; database reactivation; custom CRM and operations AI; AI SDR outbound lead generation; ecommerce AI.
- Industries with dedicated systems: med spas and aesthetic clinics, private dental practices, HVAC and plumbing, roofing, mortgage brokers, real estate and property management, freight brokers and 3PLs. Also: weight-loss clinics, solar installers, coaches, luxury auto dealers, movers, law firms, hospitals and clinics, chit funds and NBFCs.
- Delivery: about 21 days from first call to live system (discovery, architecture, build, deploy and train), then an ongoing retainer for monitoring and optimisation.
- Every system includes a reporting layer showing hours saved, calls handled and revenue recovered each week. Clients own the system and its documentation.
- Pricing (published monthly retainers, scoped after a free 20-minute audit): HVAC $5K–$12K; roofing $5K–$15K; dental $8K–$20K; med spa $10K–$25K; mortgage $10K–$25K; real estate $10K–$25K; freight $15K–$40K.
- Results from live systems in India: VS Hospitals (Chennai) — 40% fewer no-shows and zero missed after-hours calls; Panasuna Chit Funds — 100+ hours of manual work saved per month.
- Languages: English and multilingual agents (including Tamil/Tanglish); Arabic scoped per project.
